def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if r0==63: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))))
    return d
def diff():
    p,c = sig(previous_frame), sig(current_frame)
    return {k:(p.get(k),c.get(k)) for k in set(p)|set(c) if p.get(k)!=c.get(k)}

if not d or not last_action_result.get('level_completed'):

    d2 = diff()
    print('move green->gap:', 'NO CHANGE' if not d2 else {k:v[1] for k,v in d2.items()})
    print('done?', last_action_result.get('done'), 'level_completed?', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('yellow col10 rows 26-34:', [a[r][9:12] for r in range(26,34)])
print('green rows 9-11:', [a[r][26:32] for r in range(9,12)])
print('green gap rows 19-23 cols 40-44:', [a[r][40:44] for r in range(19,24)])

def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if r0==63: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))))
    return d

    p,c = sig(previous_frame), sig(current_frame)
